Configure a 2D simulation of flow past a cylinder using pimpleFoam for a transient, incompressible, laminar case.
The mesh is one cell thick.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, change the frontAndBack patches from type symmetryPlane to type empty.
In the 0/U file, set the boundary condition for frontAndBack to type empty; a value entry is optional and harmless if present.
Apply the same empty boundary condition to frontAndBack in every other field file solved by pimpleFoam, such as 0/p, to maintain consistency with the mesh definition.
Keep all other boundary conditions (inlet, outlet, cylinderWall) as already set for the flow-past-cylinder case.
Do not apply a wall or no-slip condition to the frontAndBack patches under any circumstances.
As a fallback only, the symmetryPlane pairing is acceptable: if frontAndBack remains type symmetryPlane in the boundary file, then frontAndBack must be type symmetryPlane in all field files as well.
Never mix types between the boundary file and the field files for the same patch.
